title: Mudak Style
wikitext:
A clan that consists only of people from the Russian city of Ufa. 1x1 is the most popular discipline in Ufa and the majority of Mudak Style have almost never played 4x4 before in their life.

== History ==
A first try in 4x4 by players from Ufa.

== Information ==

* Founded: February [[2007]] by Exile
* Nationality: [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] Russian
* Clan prefix: MUST
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/ufar #ufar] ([[QuakeNet]])
